errors.name: UploadNotFound
errors.description: The job ID is unknown or aged out of retention; known terminal sessions return their outcome and are never reported as not found.

errors.name: UploadNotReady
errors.description: A finish is in progress; check getUploadStatus and retry.

failureReason.description: Present only when state is failed.

completedJobId.description: Present only when state is completed.

main.description: Abort an upload only while it is created, releasing its quota reservation immediately. Terminal sessions are unchanged and return their terminal outcome. A finishing session returns UploadNotReady.
